C1_scope: Server side of recharge: product catalog, per-product history, tap grant, cards, VIP awards, card missions and privilege perks. No payment provider exists or will be called: a tap is a PRIVATE_POLICY grant (D455).
C2_client_boundary: The stock client sends nothing on a tap (VipRechargeWindow.lua:1171). The client bridge is deferred to the I11 OTA system (D460, obligation I10-RECHARGE-CLIENT-BRIDGE). Until then real clients cannot buy; the VC proves the path with a Lua step that sends the private MID and dispatches xyd.event.RECHARGE so stock onRecharge_ consumes the reply. No APK rebuild for this leaf.
C3_transport: Private HTTP MID 32000 PRESERVATION_RECHARGE_TAP in mids.sourcePlaneAliases, outside mid.lua and outside the realtime and GM masks. Params: charge_id, intent_id (client generated, 1..64 printable ASCII). Reply: {recharge_event:{mid:36857,params:{...}}, economy_}. Socket push 36857 is not produced.
C4_catalog: Content artifact charge_catalog.json from data/tables/charge.lua (23 rows), table content_charge_catalogs, capability COMMERCE_CHARGE_I9_10G, pattern summon_catalog. Card days from misc.lua: monthly_card_time2 30, season_privilege_card 90, halfyear_privilege_card 180, keyed by month_card and type. Row 013 is priced as a discount in the original; here it grants the same 30 days as 010 (PRIVATE_POLICY).
C5_grant: crystal = diamond + extra_diamond + (first_extra_diamond when charge_count is 0). VIP progress adds diamond only (D456). month_card 1 sets the month card, month_card 4 or 5 sets the privilege card. A product granting neither crystal nor a card (028, 029) is refused 409. Items are not granted: the client has no purchase path for the season and halfyear gift rows (D471).
C6_cards: D463: new_end = max(now,end) + days*86400. left days = ceil((end-now)/86400), 0 when past. Expiry is lazy; nothing writes at expiry. Week and energy cards keep their columns at 0 and no product sets them (D461).
C7_tuning: commerce_recharge_tuning singleton overlay {version, mode GRANT|DISABLED, products:{charge_id:{crystal,vip_xp,card_days,off}}}. Absent or invalid leaves the source policy. DISABLED refuses 409. D476: a validated off product is hidden from 354 and its tap is refused 409. No endpoint: I11 writes it (obligation I11-OPERATOR-TUNABLES).
C8_tap_transaction: One serializable timed transaction: FenceActorTx (315), receipt find by player+intent_id, privilege root and charge rows FOR UPDATE, SettleGrantTx crystal (700, 720, overflow not needed for scalar), PreparePrivilegeTransitionTx (700 held, 721, 730), PrepareVIPProjectionTx (740), saves, effect.Apply, directory.Apply, receipt PutTx. Ranks strictly ascend. Replay of intent_id returns the stored reply; a different charge_id on the same intent_id is a conflict.
C9_identity: Tap origin is its own class: policy_version I10_CHARGE_TAP_V1, origin_class PLAYER_TAP_PRESERVATION. The manual import keeps working on a tap-origin root and restores its own origin. monthly_state stays QUALIFIED_ABSENT: card truth lives in commerce_charge_cards.

All non-off catalog rows are returned, including never-bought rows with charge_count=0 and last_buy_time=0; D476 off products are excluded. Read-only, no locks. Registered before the inactive loop.
